FX-WAVE-001.says: The settings as they start: shape sine, height 10, width 40, direction 90, speed 0, phase 0, edges transparent. The wave runs to the right and pushes each column down by 10 sin(2 pi X / 40), more than the drawing's height across its middle: column 0 is pushed down by 0.8 pixels, column 3 by 5.2, columns 7 to 12 by more than 9, so their rows 0 to 8 are empty and row 9 keeps only part of the drawing's top row, and column 15 by 6.5; the frames are the same, the wave standing still at speed 0.

FX-WAVE-002.says: Height 0: the drawing, untouched, and nothing grows.

FX-WAVE-003.says: Height 2, width 8: a wave every eight pixels, each column pushed down or up by 2 sin(2 pi X / 8), so the blue band waves: columns 1 and 2 carry it down into rows 6 and 7 and columns 5 and 6 up into rows 2 and 3. Where a column is pushed down its top pixel reads past the drawing's top edge and loses covering, and row 9 takes the drawing's bottom row. The frames are the same.

FX-WAVE-004.says: FX-WAVE-003 with shape triangle: the zigzag pushes each pixel no further than the sine does, so the band's waves are flatter.

FX-WAVE-005.says: Direction 0: the wave runs up the drawing and pushes each row left or right, so the upright stripes wave while the band, pushed along itself, stays blue from column 3 to column 11.

FX-WAVE-006.says: Direction 45: the wave runs up and to the right and pushes along the other diagonal, so both the stripes and the band bend.

FX-WAVE-007.says: Direction 450, a whole turn past 90: FX-WAVE-003 exactly.

FX-WAVE-008.says: Direction 270 at phase 0: the wave runs left and pushes the other way, and a sine run backwards is the same sine turned over, so it is FX-WAVE-003.

FX-WAVE-009.says: Phase 90: the wave slid a quarter of the way along, so each column is pushed by 2 cos(2 pi X / 8) and the band waves two pixels further left than FX-WAVE-003's.

FX-WAVE-010.says: Speed 45: the wave travels. Frame 0 is FX-WAVE-003, frame 2 is phase 90, FX-WAVE-009, and frame 4 is phase 180, where every push is FX-WAVE-003's the other way.

FX-WAVE-011.says: FX-WAVE-003 with edges repeat: the layer does not grow, and a push past the drawing's top edge reads the drawing's top row, so where FX-WAVE-003's top pixels lose covering these keep it; every other pixel is FX-WAVE-003's.

FX-WAVE-012.says: Width 8, height keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 4 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 is the drawing, frame 2 is height 2, FX-WAVE-003, and frame 4 height 4.

FX-WAVE-013.says: Height 2, width 8, speed keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 360 at frame 4, eased past its end (477 at frame 2): frame 0 is FX-WAVE-003, and frame 2 is held at 360, so it is speed 360's frame 2.

FX-WAVE-014.says: FX-WAVE-005 moved three pixels right: the wave is worked in the drawing's own space, so it moves with it; the layer grew by 2, and the two columns left of the drawing show the grown pixels, into which the stripes are pushed, while the column left of those stays empty.

FX-WAVE-015.says: FX-WAVE-014 with edges repeat: nothing grows, so the three columns left of the drawing stay empty.

FX-WAVE-016.says: Height 2.5, width 8, direction 0, moved three pixels right: the layer grows by 3, the height rounded up, and the stripes pushed furthest left reach into the third column left of the drawing.

FX-WAVE-025.says: FX-WAVE-003 with shape circle: each half wave is half a circle, so the push rises steeply from nothing where the sine crosses the middle and stays near its full 2 pixels across most of each half wave.

FX-WAVE-026.says: FX-WAVE-025 at direction 0: the half circles run up the drawing and push each row left or right.

FX-WAVE-027.says: FX-WAVE-003 with pinning all_edges: the push fades to nothing at every edge of the drawing, reaching its whole size 4 pixels in from the left and right and 2.5 from the top and bottom, so the drawing's outline stays put and only its middle waves.

FX-WAVE-028.says: Pinning left_edge: column 0 is pushed an eighth as far as in FX-WAVE-003, column 1 three eighths, column 2 five, column 3 seven, and columns 4 on are FX-WAVE-003's.

FX-WAVE-029.says: Pinning top_edge: row 0 is pushed a fifth as far as in FX-WAVE-003, row 1 three fifths, and rows 2 on are FX-WAVE-003's.

FX-WAVE-030.says: Pinning right_edge: the drawing's right edge, past column 15, holds still; columns 12 to 15 are pushed less, and columns 0 to 11 are FX-WAVE-003's.

FX-WAVE-031.says: Pinning bottom_edge: rows 8 and 9 are pushed less, and rows 0 to 7 are FX-WAVE-003's.

FX-WAVE-032.says: Pinning horizontal_edges, the top and the bottom: FX-WAVE-029 and FX-WAVE-031 together.

FX-WAVE-033.says: Pinning vertical_edges, the left and the right: FX-WAVE-028 and FX-WAVE-030 together.

FX-WAVE-034.says: Pinning none written in the file: FX-WAVE-003 exactly.

FX-WAVE-035.says: FX-WAVE-014 with pinning all_edges: the drawing moved three pixels right, its edges still held where the drawing is, so the grown columns left of it stay empty.

FX-WAVE-036.says: FX-WAVE-025 with pinning all_edges and speed 45: the half circles travel while the edges stay put; frame 2 is a quarter wave on.

FX-WAVE-039.says: FX-WAVE-003 with shape square: columns 0 to 3 are pushed down the whole 2 pixels and columns 4 to 7 up, and again from column 8, so the band steps down and up in blocks four pixels wide.

FX-WAVE-040.says: FX-WAVE-003 with shape sawtooth: the push climbs evenly across each wave of eight columns, from 1.75 pixels one way at column 0 to 1.75 the other at column 7, then drops back at column 8.

FX-WAVE-041.says: FX-WAVE-003 with shape semicircle: one round arch a wave, pushing up most at columns 3 and 4 and 11 and 12, and the arches meeting in points at columns 0, 7, 8 and 15, all but unmoved.

FX-WAVE-042.says: FX-WAVE-041 with shape uncircle: every push the other way.

FX-WAVE-043.says: Shape noise, height 2, width 40: a fixed uneven push, a new level every two and a half pixels with straight lines between.

FX-WAVE-044.says: Shape smooth_noise, height 2, width 8: a fixed uneven push, a new level every four pixels joined smoothly.

FX-WAVE-045.says: FX-WAVE-043 with speed 45: the noise travels, the same at every frame for the same settings; frame 2 is phase 90, the pattern a quarter of 40 pixels on.

FX-WAVE-046.says: FX-WAVE-041 with pinning all_edges and direction 0: the arches run up the drawing, pushing each row left or right, held still at its edges.
